dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, you said university should be free. So you think students shouldn't pay anything at all?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, juː ˈsɛd ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ʃʊd bi ˈfriː. soʊ juː ˈθɪŋk ˈstuːdənts ˈʃʊdənt ˈpeɪ ˈɛniθɪŋ ət ˈɔːl?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not exactly. Let me clarify. What I mean is that no one should pay too much.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ɪɡˈzæktli. ˈlɛt miː ˈklærəfaɪ. ˈwʌt aɪ ˈmiːn ɪz ðæt ˈnoʊ ˌwʌn ʃʊd ˈpeɪ ˈtuː ˈmʌtʃ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Hmm, I still don't understand. Too much for who?
dialogue.reading: ˈhm, aɪ ˈstɪl ˈdoʊnt ˌʌndərˈstænd. ˈtuː ˈmʌtʃ fər ˈhuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: To put it simply, money shouldn't decide who goes to university.
dialogue.reading: tə ˈpʊt ɪt ˈsɪmpli, ˈmʌni ˈʃʊdənt dɪˈsaɪd ˈhuː ˈɡoʊz tə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I see. What worries me is the cost to the country.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsiː. ˈwʌt ˈwɜːriz miː ɪz ðə ˈkɔːst tə ðə ˈkʌntri.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I understand your concern. But the point is, the country gets the money back later.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd jʊr kənˈsɜːrn. bʌt ðə ˈpɔɪnt ɪz, ðə ˈkʌntri ˈɡɛts ðə ˈmʌni ˈbæk ˈleɪtər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: In other words, helping students also helps the country?
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈʌðər ˈwɜːrdz, ˈhɛlpɪŋ ˈstuːdənts ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈhɛlps ðə ˈkʌntri?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Exactly. What I want is a fair system for everyone.
dialogue.reading: ɪɡˈzæktli. ˈwʌt aɪ ˈwɑːnt ɪz ə ˈfɛr ˈsɪstəm fər ˈɛvriwʌn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK, now I understand your point of view. Thanks for clarifying.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, ˈnaʊ aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd jʊr ˈpɔɪnt əv ˈvjuː. ˈθæŋks fər ˈklærəfaɪɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks for asking! What I enjoyed most about the debate was hearing different opinions.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks fər ˈæskɪŋ! ˈwʌt aɪ ɪnˈdʒɔɪd ˈmoʊst əˈbaʊt ðə dɪˈbeɪt wʌz ˈhɪrɪŋ ˈdɪfərənt əˈpɪnjənz.
